answer: You're not on the Xperia anymore. The Sony Xperia 10 VI (September) was replaced in December after you dropped your phone off a bridge, and you're now on the white Nothing Phone (3a). That replaced the sourdough baking phase, which itself replaced urban sketching earlier in the year.

If you do want to revive him, take him out, give him two or three twice-daily feeds at room temperature to wake him up, and proof your dough somewhere warm (oven with the light on, around 24-26C) since a cold kitchen mostly just slows fermentation rather than killing it.

Four gyms this year: you started in January at Iron Harbor Barbell Club, paying six months up front as a commitment device for your first real strength program; in May you moved to Aqua Lane Swim & Fitness because your left knee had been hurting for two months and you wanted low impact; in late September you swapped the pool for Vertigo Climbing Co-op because chlorine hair got old fast; and in mid-December you let that lapse for Kettle & Mat Studio, since the cross-town winter commute was unbearable and the new place is a four-minute walk.
